lang.engine.cloudflareNote: Your messages stay on Cloudflare, where the portal already runs. Lower quality, and a few languages are not available.

views.site.title: Your site
views.site.setupFailed: Setting up the site stopped. We have been told; you can also try again.
views.site.intro: A real site, hosted for you, with its own address at once: a placeholder first, the real thing as it is built. Every change lands on a preview address first; nothing goes live until it is published.
views.site.making: Your site is being made. This page follows along.

views.site.publishedNotice: Published. The live site has the new version.

views.site.aheadHint: The preview has changes that are not live yet. Ali publishes them when you say they look right.
views.startSite.title: Set up {name}
views.startSite.subtitle: A real site, hosted for you, with a preview and a live address.
views.startSite.step1: Your site gets its own address at once: a placeholder page first, the real thing as it is built.
views.startSite.step2: Every change lands on the preview address first. Nothing goes live until it is published.
views.startSite.hint: Hosting and AI runs are billed at cost on the requests that use them.
views.requests.sub: Everything you have asked for, newest change first.
views.project.notOnAccount: That project is not on your account.
views.project.codeSub: Your existing code, looked after by us.
views.project.noRequests: No requests for this project yet.
views.connections.clientOnly: Connections belong to client accounts. Sign in as a client to see them.
views.keys.disconnectText: It loses access to your account at once. You can connect it again any time.
views.chatgpt.intro: Ask for work in a ChatGPT chat: “file a request to change my opening hours”, “how is my site request doing?”. It uses your own ChatGPT plan, and it can do what you can do here, nothing more. What it files waits for Ali like any other request.
views.chatgpt.step1: In ChatGPT, open Plugins, then Add → Add custom MCP server.
views.chatgpt.step3: ChatGPT sends you here to sign in. Approve it, and it shows up on this card.
views.assistants.title: Other AI assistants
views.assistants.intro: Claude, Cursor, or any assistant that speaks MCP. It sees your projects, files requests, replies and sets budgets: the same things you can do here, nothing more. Its requests wait for Ali like any other.
views.newKey.title: Connect an assistant
views.newKey.subtitle: Name it so you know which key to revoke later.
views.showKey.title: Key for {label}
views.showKey.subtitle: Copy it now: it is shown only this once.
views.showKey.hint: The assistant sends the key as "Authorization: Bearer …".
views.github.intro: Keep a project's code in your own GitHub account, or let us work on an existing private repo. You pick exactly which repos the app can reach, and can revoke it any time on GitHub.
views.github.disconnectText: Projects using this connection lose access to the repos it reached. You can reconnect any time by installing the app again.
views.cloudflare.intro: Have your sites hosted in your own Cloudflare account instead of ours: Cloudflare bills you directly, and a small site usually fits its free plan. Connecting changes nothing by itself: no site moves to your account until you ask for it. On Cloudflare you choose which account to share, and you can revoke it there or here any time.
views.cloudflare.declined: You declined on Cloudflare, so nothing was connected.
views.cloudflare.failed: Cloudflare did not finish the connection. Try again.
views.cloudflare.signin: The connection link expired. Try again from here.
views.cloudflare.disconnectText: We lose access to that Cloudflare account at once. Sites already there keep running in your account.
views.billing.sub: Ali's time at {rate} an hour, billed by the second, plus what the AI cost, with no markup.
views.billing.empty: Nothing billed yet. The meter starts when Ali or an agent works on a request.

ticket.now.new.next: Nothing starts until he approves it. Add details or files while you wait, or withdraw it at no cost.
ticket.now.approved.title: Approved, and queued for an agent

ticket.now.in_progress.title: An agent is building it
ticket.now.in_progress.next: It works on a sealed copy of your project; nothing live is touched. Replies you send now are read before it ships.

offer.step.request.title: You ask
offer.step.request.body: Sign in with your email and write what you need: in the portal, by email, or in the chat below. No call to get started.
offer.step.approve.title: I approve
offer.step.approve.body: I read every request myself. Nothing starts until I say so, and I tell you if it is the wrong thing to build.
offer.step.build.title: An agent builds
offer.step.build.body: An AI agent does the typing in a sealed copy of your project. It cannot publish, deploy, or touch anything live.
offer.step.ship.title: I check, then ship
offer.step.ship.body: I check the result before it goes anywhere. How closely is your call: a quick check that it runs, or every changed line. You follow it all in one thread.
pricing.attention.auto.name: Autopilot
pricing.attention.auto.what: The agent does the work. I approve the request and check that it runs. I do not read every line.
pricing.attention.auto.for: Text and style changes, small fixes, anything easy to undo
pricing.attention.checked.name: Checked
pricing.attention.checked.what: The agent does the work and I read every changed line before it ships.
pricing.attention.checked.for: New pages, forms, features, anything customers touch
pricing.attention.hands_on.name: Hands-on
pricing.attention.hands_on.what: I work on it with the agent: decisions, hard problems, advice.
pricing.attention.hands_on.for: Architecture, debugging the weird one, consultation
ui.gauge.noBudget: No budget set. Set one and work pauses before it passes.
